title: DV’s EVP of Business Development on OpenAI and the Power of Partnership
summary: DV’s video series covers hot topics in digital advertising from the inside. In this episode, EVP Steven Woolway discusses our partnership with OpenAI.
body_markdown:
A media effectiveness provider can only truly deliver when it’s integrated with the channels, platforms and publishers on which its customers want to advertise. DV’s Steven Woolway explains how we work with our valued partners — including, most recently, OpenAI — to provide tools and services that make advertising work better for everyone.


DV’s View From HQ video series covers hot topics in digital advertising from the inside perspective of our executives and subject matter experts.
